title: 创意兔微课 MCP 对接配置
title_en: Creative Rabbit Micro-Course MCP Integration Setup
description: 填写企业后台账号密码，用于在 WorkBuddy 中制作、查询和发布课程。账号和密码仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传至 WorkBuddy 云端。
description_en: Enter your enterprise console account to create, query, and publish courses in WorkBuddy. Credentials are stored only under ~/.workbuddy on this device and are not uploaded to the WorkBuddy cloud.
docLabel: 请使用企业后台账号密码配置
docLabel_en: Configure with your enterprise console account and password.
